hardware: Voice DSP+ V2 + ZeroCore S3 (16 MB / 8 MB PSRAM)
publication: Owner confirmed DOA, output memory and Home Assistant timer; exact installed binaries. 29 software tests plus 24 native route/mode combinations. XMOS payload and AEC/filter unchanged. No new acoustic AEC qualification claimed.
boot: Resume persistent XMOS I2S. Blank/USB-only boards require I2S Recovery first. Manual Install XMOS in Flash remains available; routine boot does not rewrite QSPI.
known_limitation: One warm OTA restart left the audio controller unavailable; full 10-second power-off recovered it.
